integrity: Exact analytic proof supplied; two independently implemented numerical programs are corroborative, not substitutes for proof.
scientific_limitations: Only constant-on-circle outer/inner weights with total angular-probability mass one are optimized.
Thin limits hold for fixed alpha in (0,1); thick midpoint window limits are uniform only for bounded lambda.
The underlying weighted annular Szego bilateral kernel is already known and not claimed as novel.
Uninspected equivalences in historic literature remain a priority risk; independent validation not performed.
title: Optimal annular Hardy boundary allocation and an exponentially oscillating thin-annulus bias
